decisions.reason: A was kept as the surviving resin injection unit after its sibling B was dropped, and holding it in a niche the firm knows well costs little, so the option stays open.
The automatic airless gun shares components with the core pump range, so keeping it is cheap and supports the established automation business.
A manual airless gun is a staple accessory that generates spare-parts and service revenue at minimal holding cost, so there is no reason to abandon it.
After four years the multi-model air-assisted line has had time to show which variants sell, but the firm can prune individual models rather than drop the whole line.
The data logger's value is still uncertain, but digital monitoring of coating equipment is gaining importance and keeping it costs little, so the option is worth holding a while longer.
